identitySignals: The website footer names 'Community Roots Curriculum Services, LLC', which matches the agenda title exactly.
The site's partner list includes Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) programs, including OUSD Literacy and African American Male Achievement.
The site says the company helps schools and districts build curriculum and instructional systems. That fits a Chief Academic Officer or Office of Equity services agreement.

The site's leader biography describes work as a district academic leader in Oakland, CA, and says he lives in Oakland. I did not research him further, and the cited pages don't give the company's address.
research.notes: I found no registry entry (California Secretary of State, SAM.gov) in the searches, so the entity number, SAM.gov UEI, EIN, phone and street address are null. EIN is not expected for an LLC. The agenda gave no city, so the Oakland headquarters rests only on the site's biography text and the OUSD partnership. The organization's own website is a Google Sites page. A reviewer could confirm the entity number on bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov.

profile.summary: A company that consults with schools, districts and community organizations on curriculum and instruction. It helps them set up systems for using high-quality instructional materials, such as professional learning, assessment and coaching. It also helps them connect lessons to local history, culture and community.

What We Do - Community Roots Curriculum Services

review.notes: I fetched the cited Google Sites pages. Their footer names 'Community Roots Curriculum Services, LLC' and gives info@communityrootscurriculum.org, the partner list includes OUSD Literacy and African American Male Achievement, and the described curriculum and instructional-systems consulting matches an Office of Equity services agreement; the summary is neutral and supported by the What We Do and Who We Are pages. I dropped the Oakland, CA headquarters because it rests only on the founder's biography (his past district role and home in Oakland), and no source gives a company location.
